mapper.select:
SELECT sup.id, sup.code, sup.voucher_no as voucherNo, sup.create_user_id AS createUserId, sup.create_user_name AS createUserName, sup.create_time AS createTime, sup.name, sup.approve_status AS approveStatus, sup.phase, sup.grade_id AS gradeId, sup.category_id AS categoryId , sup.disabled AS disabled, sup.srm_disabled AS srmDisabled, sup.pay_method_id AS payMethodId, sup.payment_condition as paymentCondition, sup.purchase_user_id AS purchaseUserId, sup.purchase_user_name AS purchaseUserName, sup.po_follower_id as poFollowerId, sup.approve_time as approveTime,
sc.person as person, sc.position as position, sc.tel_number as telNumber, sc.email as email, sc.is_default as contactIsDefault, sc.disabled as contactDisabled, sc.remark as contactRemark, sa.payee as payee, sa.bank_name as bankName, sa.bank_account as bankAccount, sa.bank_subbranch as bankSubbranch, sa.pay_method_id as payMethodId, sa.is_default as accountDefault, sa.remark as accountRemark, scr.id as credentialId, scr.name as credentialName, scr.effective_date as effectiveDate, scr.expire_date as expireDate, scr.remark as credentialRemark,
sup.identification_code as identificationCode, sup.registered_capital as registeredCapital, sup.property_json as propertyJson, sup.product_category_json as productCategoryJson, sup.certificate_json as certificateJson, sup.application_category_json as applicationCategoryJson FROM supplier sup
left join supplier_contact sc on sup.id = sc.supplier_id and sc.is_deleted = false left join supplier_account sa on sup.id = sa.supplier_id and sa.is_deleted = false left join supplier_credential scr on sup.id = scr.supplier_id and scr.is_deleted = false
WHERE ${params.sqlMap.default} AND sup.is_deleted=FALSE
${params.permissionSql}
ORDER BY
${item.field} ${item.sort}
sup.create_time DESC

select id,name as value,code,disabled,payment_condition from ( select sup.id, sup.name, sup.code, sup.payment_condition, sup.disabled from supplier sup where sup.is_deleted = false
and ((sup.code = #{params.searchKeyword}) or (sup.id = #{params.searchKeyword}) or sup.name ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%'))
and sup.disabled=#{params.disabled}
and sup.approve_status in
#{item}
order by
case when sup.name ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 when sup.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text) THEN 2 when sup.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 3 end , sup.name,
sup.code asc,sup.disabled asc ) supplier
